notes.theta_star_defect: The preregistered theta* rule (largest theta with max_H_lost<=2*theta and perm>=0.80) selected theta=1.0, at which G5 is vacuous (identical to G0). The Part C G5 cell is therefore INCONCLUSIVE for the graded guard; a supplementary non-preregistered sweep at theta in {0.05,0.10,0.25} is reported separately.
notes.part_d_throughput_defect: Nominal throughput counts admitted-but-rolled-back actions. At k=1 every round was rolled back (30/30), so nominal 4.00 corresponds to effective 0.00. Effective throughput is reported alongside.
notes.harness_bug_fixed: run_round evaluated the invariant BEFORE commit, reporting G2 violations as 0 while its counter stood at 16 against a budget of 6. Found by the mandated diagnose-any-exact-zero check; fixed by cloning the guard per application order, committing, then evaluating on the joint state. Part C re-run in full.
